newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tempora up on better-than-expected results.
newsitem.headline: Tempora up on better-than-expected results.

text.p: Shares in South African investment firm Tempora Investments Ltd rose on Tuesday to a new year high after the company posted a slight improvement in its earnings for the year ended June 30, dealers said.
By about 0807 GMT Tempora was up 20 cents to 28.00 rand after 62,500 shares worth around 1.75 million rand changed hands.
"They've announced their results this morning and they were a little bit better...I think it's on the back of this that the share is up," one Johannesburg Stock Exchange dealer said.
Tempora's headline earnings per share was eight percent up at 79.8 cents from 73.6 cents the previous year. The dividend dipped to 44.1 cents from 50.0 cents.
